observed_reality.sqlite_primary_source_result: SQLite documents the WAL-reset corruption bug through 3.51.2 and fixed in 3.51.3 and later; SQLite 3.53.4 is on the fixed side.
observed_reality.candidate_bug: attest_connection() performed Path(expected_db).resolve(strict=True) before os.lstat(expected_db), so a final-component caller-supplied symlink was erased before the intended S_ISLNK fail-closed check.

hypothesis: A caller-supplied canonical DB path that is itself a symlink can bypass the candidate's intended symlink rejection because Path.resolve() replaces the symlink path with its regular-file target before lstat()/S_ISLNK runs.
strongest_counterhypothesis: SQLite filename normalization or later HAS_MOVED/WAL identity checks might independently reject all such symlink inputs, making the pre-resolve symlink check redundant rather than security-relevant.
